parent.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object's new parent.

object.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object to be copied.

autoAddToSourceControl.description: Determines if Wwise automatically performs an Add source control operation for affected work units. Defaults to true.

onNameConflict.description: The action to take if "parent" already has a child with the same name. Default value is "fail".

autoCheckOutToSourceControl.description: Determines if Wwise automatically performs a Checkout source control operation for affected work units and for the project. Defaults to true.

optionsSchema.description: Specifies the return options for every object created.

examples.description: Copies the object specified by the "object" ID and makes that copy a child of "parent". The object is renamed if "parent" already contains a child with the same name.
examples.title: Copying an object to the given parent
